blocks.text: Yeh aam observation (dekhi hui baat) hai ke different (alag alag) chemical reactions ki rates (raftar) mein bohat farq hota hai. Maslan NaCl ka AgNO₃ ke saath reaction bohat tez hai. Ester ka hydrolysis (pani se tootna) moderate (darmiyani) rate se hota hai. Jabke iron (loha) ko rust (zang) lagna ek slow process (dheere hone wala kaam) hai.

blocks.title: Reaction kinetics
blocks.text: Reaction kinetics chemical reactions ki rates (raftar) ka study (parhai) hai.
Is mein reaction ki rates, orders aur mechanisms napne ke kai experimental (tajurbe wale) methods (tareeqe) shamil hain.

Explosion (dhamaka) ek bohat tez reaction hai jo second ke ek hisse mein ho jata hai, jabke iron ko rust lagne mein din ya mahine lag sakte hain. Explosion ke dauran hone wali reactions ki rates bohat zyada hoti hain.

Industry mein reactions ki rates aur un par control aksar bohat aham hota hai. Yahi faisla karti hain ke koi reaction economically (kam kharch mein) istemal ho sakti hai ya nahi. Bohat se factors reaction ki rate par asar karte hain, is liye woh conditions (halaat) dhoondna zaroori hai jin mein reaction sab se kam kharch mein chale.

Collision theory batati hai ke reactions kaise hoti hain. Is theory ke mutabiq reaction hone ke liye reactants ke particles (atoms, ions ya molecules) ko homogeneous (har jagah ek jaisa) mixture banana aur aapas mein takrana zaroori hai. Yeh collisions (takkar) particles ki energy ke hisaab se effective (kaamyab) ya ineffective (nakaam) ho sakte hain. Effective collision se products bante hain; warna particles bas takra kar wapas uchhal jate hain. Effective collision tab hi hota hai jab particles ke paas kaafi energy ho aur woh proper orientation (sahi rukh) se aa kar takrayein.

blocks.title: Activation energy
blocks.text: Reacting particles ke darmiyan effective collision ke liye jo kam se kam energy chahiye, use activation energy kehte hain.
Zyada tar reactions slow hoti hain; is se pata chalta hai ke har collision barabar effective nahi hota.

Is process ko path of reaction (reaction ka rasta) aur molecules ki potential energy ke graph se samjha ja sakta hai. Collision effective ho to alag hone wale molecules chemically naye hote hain; warna wahi molecules wapas uchhal jate hain. Reactants curve ki peak (choti) par pohanch kar activated complex banate hain. Sirf woh molecules jin ke paas poori activation energy ho, yeh 'pahari' charh kar products bana sakte hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Socho ke ek gaind ko pahari ke paar pohanchana hai. Pahari ki unchai activation energy hai. Jis gaind mein kaafi zor (energy) ho aur woh sahi taraf (orientation) jaye, wahi paar hoti hai; baqi wapas aa jati hain. Isi tarah sirf kuch collisions products banate hain.

blocks.prompt: a) Reaction hone ke liye collision frequency aur molecules ka orientation zaroori conditions (shartein) hain. Is baat ko justify (daleel se sabit) karein.
blocks.explanation: Molecules jab tak milenge (takrayenge) nahi, react nahi kar sakte; is liye zyada collisions ka matlab reaction ke zyada mauqe. Lekin collision tab hi effective hai jab molecules sahi orientation (rukh) se takrayein; ghalat orientation se takrane wale molecules bina badle wapas chale jate hain.

blocks.prompt: b) Chemical reactions mein activation energy ka kya role (kirdar) hai?
blocks.explanation: Activation energy woh kam se kam energy hai jo collision ko effective banane ke liye chahiye. Yeh ek barrier (rukawat) hai: sirf woh molecules jo is se zyada energy rakhte hain activated complex bana kar products dete hain.

blocks.prompt: c) Activation energy reaction ki rate par kaise asar karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Activation energy jitni zyada, utne kam molecules barrier paar kar pate hain aur reaction utni slow hoti hai. Activation energy kam ho to zyada collisions effective hote hain aur reaction tez hoti hai.

items: Reaction kinetics reactions ki rates ki study hai: NaCl + AgNO₃ bohat tez, ester hydrolysis moderate, rust slow.
Collision theory: particles kaafi energy (kam se kam activation energy) aur sahi orientation se takrayein to hi products bante hain; reactants curve ki choti par activated complex banate hain.
